notes:
# Blackline 0.15.123

* Share → Best quality: the screen goes straight from Windows into the call, skipping the step that draws every frame as a picture first — sharper, and about a frame quicker. Windows does the asking instead of the Blackline picker; that is the whole trade, and the switch says so. Off by default.
* The frame rate and size you choose now apply to that path too.
* A probe for a real call: test/audit/probe-call-quality.mjs prints what is actually arriving and going out — codec, size, frames a second, Mb/s, freezes, round trip.
